meta.title: Our Portfolio | ASSETRA investments
meta.description: Portfolio of small local businesses we co-own — Ensola, Woodsteel, History Caffe & Bakery, EUROSCAFF, and real estate projects.

hero.label: Portfolio
hero.title: Our
hero.description: We build and co-own a portfolio of small local businesses with growth potential across various industries.

ensola.name: Ensola
ensola.description: Sales and installation of heat pumps, smart home solutions, and photovoltaic systems. Modern energy solutions for homes and businesses.

woodsteel.name: Woodsteel
woodsteel.description: Manufacturing and installation of glass enclosures, pergolas, and conservatories. Currently operating in three countries — Slovakia, Czech Republic, and Austria.

historyCaffe.name: History Caffe & Bakery
historyCaffe.description: A local cafe with its own bakery. An authentic concept combining quality coffee with freshly baked pastries.

euroscaff.name: EUROSCAFF
euroscaff.description: A construction company and staffing agency in the construction sector operating in the German market. Providing qualified workforce for construction projects.

pendingAcquisition.label: Ongoing Acquisition
pendingAcquisition.title: Expanding our portfolio
pendingAcquisition.text: We are currently in the process of acquiring a company focused on trading metallurgical materials. Details will be published upon completion of the transaction.

realEstateDivision.label: Real Estate Division
realEstateDivision.title: Brixstone Capital
realEstateDivision.text: Through Brixstone Capital, we trade real estate within the territory of the Slovak Republic. We own land, apartments, and houses across Slovakia.

project.label: Real Estate Project
project.title: Nové Šútovce 1
project.text: Sale of building plots in Šútovce. Prepared parcels on a gentle slope with complete infrastructure (utilities + road). An ideal location in the Upper Nitra Basin ensures quick construction and unobstructed views of the surrounding countryside.
project.partner: Completed in partnership with BAK spol. s.r.o.
